Morin (maintainer, [2013](https://www.spinics.net/lists/kernel/msg1627738.html)-[2017](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/1972d6c0c86dd8620ff9f2811ce875135ffb5405)), Masahiro Yamada (maintainer, [2018](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/50186e121ea1adcc43d0f9f790ee45e0b0f1202f)-[2025](https://web.git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/commit/?id=8d6841d5cb20)), Nathan Chancellor (odd fixes, [2025](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20251023-update-kconfig-maintainers-v1-1-0ebd5b4ecced@kernel.org/)-), Nicolas Schier (odd fixes, [2025](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20251023-update-kconfig-maintainers-v1-1-0ebd5b4ecced@kernel.org/)-), Julian Braha (reviewer, [2026](https://lore.kernel.org/linux-kbuild/20260804141436.1451211-1-julianbraha@gmail.com/)-)
Notes: original implementation from the Linux kernel, maintained in the kernel repository (Linux Foundation) and cloned-and-owned into many [system-specific](#systems) repositories

Python alternative to LKC, significantly [extends](https://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/build/kconfig/extensions.html) LKC (see [Ðorđević26](https://elias-kuiter.de/publications/#Dordevic26)), maintained by the Zephyr project (Linux Foundation), but in a separate repository
Rust alternative to LKC, only implements a parser, maintained in a separate repository
Python alternative to LKC, only implements a simplified subset of KConfig and no configuration tools, maintained in the QEMU repository
small C alternative to LKC, only implements a parser, maintained in the toybox repository

Authors: Gregory Nutt, Brennan Ashton, Yann E. Morin, Ross Burton, Angus Gratton, Ivan Grokhotkov (and others)
Notes: these are various attempts at extracting LKC into a standalone package (i.e., they are all based on LKC), which can be installed with, e.g., `sudo apt install kconfig-frontends`; however, there is no agreed-upon location for this package, and all are outdated (2020 and earlier)

Authors: Wang Nan, Luis Chamberlain, Christophe Guillon, Boris Kolpackov
Notes: these are various additional attempts at extracting LKC into a standalone package (i.e., they are all based on LKC), none of which are shipped in Linux distributions (in contrast to kconfig-frontends); most are outdated, [kbuild-standalone](https://github.com/WangNan0/kbuild-standalone) is the most recent (LKC v6.9); approach discussed by [Luis Chamberlain](https://lwn.net/Articles/767691/), [Masahiro Yamada](https://lkml.org/lkml/2018/10/5/438), [Ulf Magnusson](https://lkml.org/lkml/2018/10/6/165), [Rob Landley](https://lkml.iu.edu/hypermail/linux/kernel/0707.1/2803.html)
these are various templates/skeletons for quickly starting a new project based on KBuild and KConfig with an in-tree copy of LKC (i.e., they are all based on LKC), all are outdated (2016 and earlier)
